decisions.rationale: Hawlucha Taunts Farigiraf through Armor Tail (non-priority), Krookodile Intimidates and threatens with Knock Off. Charizard-Y in back sets sun after Altaria is handled; Sinistcha redirects and heals. Handles both Trick Room and Tailwind modes while preserving sun for late-game. If Whimsicott leads, Krookodile Knock Off + Hawlucha Acrobatics pressure it; Heat Wave from Charizard later cleans.

Lead Whimsicott/Farigiraf: establish Prankster Tailwind and immediately threaten Hawlucha with Farigiraf Psychic, while Armor Tail prevents opposing priority disruption. Rotom-Wash is the Charizard-Y answer; Mega Metagross is the intended late-game Mega once Fire pressure is controlled, using Tailwind to clean.

Acrobatics+EQ punishes their most likely Tailwind opener while Hawlucha is EQ-immune. Acrobatics breaks Sash; EQ threatens the KO through it and chips Farigiraf for 25–48%. Even if Whimsicott Protects, Farigiraf takes EQ and we waste their Prankster turn. The line beats Tailwind+Gleam, Taunt+TR (Acrobatics still fires through Taunt), and double-target Hawlucha (we move first).
decisions.notebook: Opponent habit: heavy Protect reliance when cornered. Arcanine willing to sacrifice with Flare Blitz into Fighting-types. Farigiraf (Sassy, Trick Room, Armor Tail) and Altaria (Calm, Cloud Nine, Tailwind) remain unplayed in series; likely to appear in G3. Whimsicott Focus Sash consumed in G2 but restored for G3. Plan: fast pressure with Hawlucha/Krookodile; preserve Charizard-Y to re-set sun if Altaria switches in.

decisions.rationale: Charizard-Y immediately threatens Whimsicott (guaranteed OHKO Heat Wave in sun) and heavily damages Farigiraf. Krookodile can Protect next turn to safely scout double-target, or Knock Off Farigiraf. Sinistcha is tanky but slower and passive, giving opponent free Tailwind turns. Charizard's offensive pressure forces the opponent to react, preserving our momentum.
decisions.notebook: G3: Opponent leads Whimsicott (Sash intact at 16%) + Farigiraf (Sitrus Berry). Tailwind set, 4 turns remain. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks our priority moves. Opponent habit: Protect when cornered. Hawlucha fainted. Bring Charizard-Y to reset sun and pressure. Preserve Krookodile for Metagross/Rotom-Wash. Opponent back: Metagross-Mega, Rotom-Wash (Wacan Berry), Arcanine (Intimidate), Altaria (Cloud Nine). Plan: Charizard-Y Heat Wave + Krookodile Protect or Knock Off Farigiraf. If Altaria switches, sun re-set still valuable.

decisions.rationale: Tailwind is secured before Hawlucha’s Taunt and gives Rotom-Wash and Mega Metagross the needed endgame speed. Psychic threatens Hawlucha directly rather than accepting its Acrobatics pressure; if it Protects, Tailwind still creates the favorable next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has shown Hawlucha-Krookodile as a game-3 lead mode. Preserve Rotom-Wash and use Tailwind to support Rotom-Wash plus Mega Metagross endgame; do not make Mega Metagross the sole Hawlucha-Krookodile answer.

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave from Mega Y in sun OHKOs Whimsicott (110-260%) and chunks Farigiraf (42-95%). Protect shields Krookodile from the Moonblast OHKO range (40-120%) and Dazzling Gleam (20-70%). Encore locking into EQ is manageable: switch Krookodile next turn. Sun resets weather for the endgame vs Metagross/Rotom-Wash/Arcanine.
decisions.notebook: G3: Opponent leads Whimsicott (Sash, Prankster) + Farigiraf (Sitrus Berry, Armor Tail). Armor Tail blocks all priority including Rage Powder. Whimsicott moves: Tailwind, Taunt, Moonblast, Encore. Farigiraf: Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, Trick Room, Protect. Opponent back: Metagross-Mega, Rotom-Wash (Wacan Berry), Arcanine (Intimidate), Altaria (Cloud Nine). Krookodile preserved for Metagross/Rotom-Wash. Sinistcha in back for late-game recovery. Plan: set sun with Charizard-Y, remove Whimsicott, then pressure with Heat Wave + Krookodile/switch.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Encore forces Krookodile off a possible Protect and into its revealed Earthquake. Farigiraf avoids Mega Charizard Y Heat Wave this turn, while the likely Whimsicott loss gives a safe Rotom-Wash entry against locked Earthquake with Tailwind still active.

Rotom-Wash is the safe preservation switch: it is immune to Krookodile's Earthquake via Levitate and resists Charizard's Heat Wave. Metagross would enter directly into both Ground- and Fire-type pressure. Rotom also retains Tailwind-supported Thunderbolt pressure on Charizard next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's game-3 Hawlucha-Krookodile lead transitions into Mega Charizard Y plus Krookodile. Preserve Rotom-Wash and use Tailwind to support Rotom-Wash plus Mega Metagross endgame; do not make Mega Metagross the sole Hawlucha-Krookodile answer.

decisions.rationale: Charizard Protect blocks the likely Thunderbolt OHKO threat. Krookodile Knock Off into Farigiraf removes Sitrus Berry and does 45-84%, potentially KOing at high roll. Even if Farigiraf survives and sets Trick Room, it's severely weakened. Krookodile survives Rotom Hydro Pump + DazzlingGleam with Sitrus Berry triggering mid-sequence. Next turn Tailwind is on its last turn and we can clean up with Charizard's sun offense.

Rotom is guaranteed faster under Tailwind and Thunderbolt threatens the immediate Charizard KO. Switching preserves Farigiraf from Krookodile's Dark attack and brings Metagross safely through the likely Charizard Protect line; Rotom is immune to Krookodile Earthquake.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s game-3 Hawlucha-Krookodile lead transitions into Mega Charizard Y plus Krookodile. Preserve Rotom-Wash and use Tailwind to support Rotom-Wash plus Mega Metagross endgame; do not make Mega Metagross the sole Hawlucha-Krookodile answer.

decisions.rationale: Metagross at 36% almost certainly Protects; Rotom likely Thunderbolts Charizard. Heat Wave KOs Metagross if it doesn't Protect and chips Rotom; Knock Off removes Wacan Berry and damages Rotom. If Charizard falls to Thunderbolt, Krookodile still lands Knock Off. Tailwind expires next turn, giving my faster mons the advantage with Sinistcha in back. Earthquake is wasted on Rotom's Levitate, making Knock Off strictly better.
decisions.notebook: G3: Opponent leads Whimsicott (Sash, Prankster) + Farigiraf (Sitrus Berry, Armor Tail). Armor Tail blocks all priority including Rage Powder. Whimsicott: Tailwind, Taunt, Moonblast, Encore. Farigiraf: Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, Trick Room, Protect. Back: Metagross-Mega, Rotom-Wash (Wacan Berry, Levitate). Rotom Levitate confirmed: Ground immune. Knock Off removes Wacan Berry. Metagross at 36% likely Protects when vulnerable. Opponent Tailwind expires turn 5; my speed advantage returns. Sinistcha preserved for endgame.

decisions.rationale: Rotom-Wash is guaranteed to move before Charizard under the final Tailwind turn, and Thunderbolt is a guaranteed OHKO by the damage range. Mega Protect prevents Krookodile from immediately removing Metagross with Knock Off or Earthquake while securing the key Charizard removal.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has shown Hawlucha-Krookodile into Mega Charizard Y plus Krookodile. Preserve Rotom-Wash as the Charizard answer and use Mega Metagross as the Krookodile pressure piece; Farigiraf remains the Trick Room fallback once Tailwind ends.

decisions.rationale: Rotom dies to burn at end of turn regardless. Double Protect guarantees both my mons survive, blocks all opponent attacks (both Protects at full 100% success rate), and Metagross's Protect is risky from consecutive use. Turn 6: Charizard+Krookodile vs Metagross(36%)+Farigiraf with 1 turn of sun left—Heat Wave + Knock Off cleans up. No need to risk Charizard or Krookodile being KO'd this turn.
decisions.notebook: G3: Opponent leads Whimsicott (Sash, Prankster) + Farigiraf (Sitrus Berry, Armor Tail). Armor Tail blocks all priority including Rage Powder. Whimsicott: Tailwind, Taunt, Moonblast, Encore. Farigiraf: Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, Trick Room, Protect. Back: Metagross-Mega, Rotom-Wash (Wacan Berry consumed, Levitate). Rotom Levitate confirmed: Ground immune. Knock Off removes Wacan Berry. Metagross at 36% likely Protects when vulnerable. Opponent Tailwind expires turn 5; my speed advantage returns. Sinistcha preserved for endgame. Opponent may double-target Charizard when it's low; Protect reads are effective.

decisions.rationale: Zen Headbutt is a guaranteed KO on the revealed 7% Charizard before either foe can move if it does not Protect. Rotom Protect denies Krookodile's likely Knock Off/Earthquake and preserves the Charizard answer. If Charizard Protects, this still avoids exposing Rotom while forcing its only realistic escape line.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Game 3 mode includes Mega Charizard Y plus Krookodile, with Hawlucha-Krookodile lead shown. Charizard has Heat Wave, Solar Beam, Scorching Sands, Protect; Krookodile has Earthquake, Knock Off, Close Combat, Protect. Charizard used Protect on turn 3; Krookodile used Protect on turn 2. Preserve Rotom-Wash for Charizard where possible; Mega Metagross pressures Krookodile with Hammer Arm. Farigiraf is the remaining Trick Room fallback.

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave KOs both foes from current HP if Charizard moves (min 77.5% on 36% Metagross, 22.9% on 2% Rotom). Knock Off Metagross adds insurance. If Metagross outspeeds and KOs Charizard, Rotom dies to burn and Krookodile still damages Metagross; Sinistcha cleans endgame. No better line exists given speed uncertainty and reduced Protect rates on both sides.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Metagross is faster than both foes and must remove the 7% Charizard before Heat Wave can take it out. Zen Headbutt is neutral and should easily finish Charizard, unlike resisted Meteor Mash. Rotom cannot safely act before either foe; its reduced Protect is still its only chance to avoid being removed while preserving Farigiraf for the Krookodile endgame.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has shown willingness to spend coordinated Protect turns to buy positioning. Against Charizard-Y plus Krookodile, prioritize immediately removing Charizard with Mega Metagross when it is in range; keep Farigiraf available as the Trick Room/Armor Tail endgame piece rather than exposing it to a likely double target.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf is the only remaining Pokémon and must replace one fainted slot; the other slot must pass. Preserve its Armor Tail and Trick Room option against Krookodile plus the opponent's final unrevealed selection.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has shown willingness to use coordinated Protect turns for positioning. Against Charizard-Y plus Krookodile, immediately removing Charizard when in range was correct. Preserve Farigiraf as the Armor Tail/Trick Room endgame piece when possible.

decisions.rationale: Both attacks outrun Farigiraf. Knock Off (45-84%) + Matcha Gotcha (21-39%) minimum 66.5% > 66% HP, guaranteeing KO if both hit. Matcha Gotcha 90% accuracy is the only risk; even on miss, Knock Off has a high-roll KO chance. Trick Room is -7 and never goes up before the KO. Farigiraf is the last foe; KO ends the game.
decisions.notebook: G3: Opponent brings Whimsicott/Farigiraf/Metagross-Mega/Rotom-Wash. Armor Tail blocks all priority including Rage Powder. Farigiraf carries Trick Room, Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, Protect. Opponent prefers Protect when vulnerable. Rotom Levitate confirmed immune to Ground.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf cannot safely set Trick Room while Krookodile threatens immediate super-effective Knock Off. Protect is the only line that prevents the direct KO this turn and can punish an opponent attempting a coordinated Protect or nonattacking Sinistcha line; attacking does not remove either foe reliably through spread reduction.

Krookodile outspeeds and Knock Off is super-effective with high KO chance. Matcha Gotcha adds insurance damage. Even if both roll minimum and Farigiraf survives, Dazzling Gleam can't OHKO either mon back. Rage Powder blocked by Armor Tail. Farigiraf's Protect success is reduced. Double attack maximizes win probability this turn.
decisions.notebook: G3: Opponent brings Whimsicott/Farigiraf/Metagross-Mega/Rotom-Wash. Armor Tail blocks all priority including Rage Powder. Farigiraf carries Trick Room, Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, Protect. Farigiraf Protect used turns 2 and 7; success rate now reduced. Opponent prefers Protect when vulnerable.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Krookodile is guaranteed faster and Knock Off is super effective, so every proactive move risks immediate loss before it resolves. Consecutive Protect is reduced odds, but it is the only line that can deny the immediate KO and preserve a subsequent chance to exploit an opposing Protect or passive Sinistcha action.

reflections.summary: Krookodile's super-effective Knock Offs removed Metagross and Farigiraf, while the opponent's consecutive Protect on Farigiraf failed turn 8, leaving it vulnerable to the finishing blow. The favorable trade on turn 6 (Charizard for Metagross and Rotom) created a 2v1 advantage that Krookodile and Sinistcha easily closed.
reflections.adjustment: Preserve Hawlucha to Taunt Farigiraf and deny Trick Room, and consider leading Krookodile to apply immediate Dark-type pressure on the opponent's Psychic- and Ghost-weak core.
reflections.notebook: G3: Opponent brings Whimsicott/Farigiraf/Metagross-Mega/Rotom-Wash. Armor Tail blocks all priority including Rage Powder. Farigiraf carries Trick Room, Psychic, Dazzling Gleam, Protect. Farigiraf Protect used turns 2 and 7; success rate now reduced. Opponent prefers Protect when vulnerable, sometimes consecutively, risking failure. Farigiraf did not use Trick Room under pressure. Metagross and Farigiraf are weak to Dark; Krookodile's Knock Off is highly effective. Rotom-W's Wacan Berry consumed early; vulnerable to Knock Off. Whimsicott likely leads with Tailwind support.

reflections.summary: Lost because the Charizard trade left no sustainable answer to Krookodile plus Sinistcha; the Metagross/Rotom/Whimsicott/Farigiraf four and Mega Metagross plan did not cover that backline well enough.
reflections.adjustment: At preview, avoid committing this exact four/Mega Metagross into Charizard-Y + Krookodile + Sinistcha unless a bench option can pressure the Krookodile-Sinistcha endgame; preserve a dedicated answer to that pair rather than trading everything to remove Charizard.
reflections.notebook: Opponent has used coordinated Protects for positioning. Krookodile carries Sitrus Berry and repeatedly pressures with Knock Off. Sinistcha can be held for a Krookodile-supported endgame. Removing Charizard-Y alone is insufficient; retain an endgame answer to Krookodile plus Sinistcha.
